bio:
Sanic is an iconic internet meme variant of Sonic the Hedgehog that officially debuted on March 31, 2010. He was created by YouTuber 0nyxheart in a satirical MS Paint video titled "HOW 2 DRAW SANIC HEGEHOG". Born as a parody of poorly drawn fan art and intentionally abysmal grammar, Sanic quickly evolved into a staple of the early 2010s internet culture, heavily associated with MLG (Major League Gaming) montages, loud distorted music, and Garry's Mod videos. The character became so widely recognized that SEGA and Paramount later officially acknowledged him through a cosmetic green shirt in the game Sonic Forces and a quick easter egg sketch by Crazy Carl in the live-action Sonic the Hedgehog Movie.

However,Sanic.exe serves as a complete joke/parody character who stars in the hidden unlockable track "Too Fest" since Vs. Sonic.exe 2.0. Categorized as a "homicidal meme," he takes the dark, terrifying premise of the original Sonic.exe creepypasta and plays it entirely for laughs. Within his own parody lore, he is described as a violent stoner who spends his time smoking weed and hunting down distorted versions of Sonic's friends—such as "Taels Maels Prawere," "Knacklos," and "Eggmun"—while blasting ear-rape music to taunt them.
